Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes ([a] two verifiable FBS test results of 140 mg/dl or above or [b] taking or have taken insulin or hypoglycemic agents for at least one year in the past)
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has type 2 diabetes diagnosed at age 48, currently managed with metformin for over 10 years (age 48 to 58).
Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: A family member, preferably a spouse or first-degree relative, who agrees to participate
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has a family history of cardiovascular disease (paternal father died at 62 from sudden cardiac death), but no explicit information is provided about a family member agreeing to participate.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Migrant farm workers (not available for the year-long program)
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is a 58-year-old male with no indication of being a migrant farm worker.
Patient is male; pregnancy is not applicable.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Medical conditions for which changes in diet and exercise levels would be contraindicated
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has severe coronary artery disease (Stage III, multivessel involvement, impaired left ventricular function), recurrent myocardial infarctions, and ischemic cardiomyopathy. These conditions likely contraindicate significant changes in diet and exercise.

Recap: Patient meets diabetes and willingness criteria but lacks confirmation of a participating family member. Exclusion criterion related to contraindicated diet/exercise changes is violated due to severe cardiac comorbidities.
